label: CONTROLLED SYNTHETIC EVALUATION - THRESHOLD CURVE
protocol: All metrics computed on identical held-out test set (n=16200, positive share 5.12%); thresholds evaluated on raw (pre-calibration) scores and Platt-calibrated probabilities

0.30.note: High recall, low precision — suitable for broad sweep scenarios

0.40.note: Balanced operating point — F1 maximum near this threshold

0.50.note: Equal precision/recall crossover; naive threshold for comparison

0.60.note: Precision drops below 40%; suitable only for CRITICAL-tier actions

0.70.note: DEFAULT operational threshold — recommended for LEA dispatch + bank review

0.80.note: High precision, very low recall — suitable for CRITICAL-only actions

0.85.note: Above 0.85 = dispatch tier with fairness cap; each alert requires HOLd ACTION evidence review

0.90.note: Extreme precision, tiny recall — reserve for most urgent LEA escalation only

0.95.note: Near-zero recall — only for extraordinary circumstances; not recommended for routine dispatch

default_operational.rationale: Best balance of precision (28.6%) and recall (22.2%) for limited-intervention dispatch; concentrates reviewer attention on 30-60 highest-risk ATM/cycles at 67-75% precision; not a national-recall claim (base rate ~5%)
default_operational.expected_per_intervention: At K=10: CashGuard captures 3.3% of fraud at 4.12x volume lift; Rs27,139 exposure prevented per intervention vs Rs7,223 for volume-based dispatch
default_operational.recommended_action: Review recommended — enhanced monitoring + notify local police station

critical_dispatch.rationale: Precision 16.3% — only 1 in 6 flagged ATMs actually involve fraud; reserved for cases where the cost of a false positive is very low and the risk of missing a critical event is severe; each alert requires HOLD ACTION evidence review before dispatch
critical_dispatch.recommended_action: Review recommended — verify evidence, then coordinate branch + police station

hold_action_zone.rationale: Near-threshold alerts (0.70 <= risk_score < 0.85) fall in the HOLD ACTION zone: intelligence is present but not yet strong enough for immediate dispatch/action. These alerts should: (1) be reviewed by a second human, (2) have evidence strength assessed, (3) potentially be escalated if risk materializes within 24h, (4) be demoted to MONITOR if no escalation observed within cooldown window
hold_action_zone.holding_policy: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE — HOLD ACTION (review recommended; evidence below strength threshold)
evidence_requirements: Top-3 feature contributions with instance percentiles
Uncertainty block with data freshness and model disagreement

honest_limits: Threshold curve on single held-out split — results may vary with different data epochs
Precision at 0.70 = 28.6% reflects 5.1% base rate; real-world base rates will shift precision
F1 scores are misleading when positive/negative imbalance is extreme (5:95 ratio)
All results from CONTROLLED SYNTHETIC EVALUATION — real-world threshold calibration required
The 0.70 default threshold is a demo starting point; ops should re-derive for their jurisdiction
